title: 污泥熱水解前處理
summary: 本課以熱水解前處理與消化系統整合為主線，從污泥組成與進料邊界、水解顯熱模型、蒸汽熱焓收支、熱回收與溫位進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops thermal-hydrolysis pretreatment and digestion integration through ten connected units, beginning with sludge composition and feed boundary, hydrolysis sensible-heat model, steam enthalpy balance, recovery and temperature grade. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 污泥組成與進料邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sludge composition and feed boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污泥組成與進料邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sludge composition and feed boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 初沉與生物污泥的可水解性不同，先確認混合比例與乾固體。
steps.instructionEn: Primary and biological sludges differ in hydrolysability; establish blend and dry solids first.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
steps.failure: 只看濕重忽略組成。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。
steps.failureEn: Wet weight alone hides composition. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「污泥組成與進料邊界」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge composition and feed boundary. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 水解顯熱模型：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Hydrolysis sensible-heat model: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水解顯熱模型 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Hydrolysis sensible-heat model and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 教學模型以質量與溫升估算基本熱量，壓力容器狀態必須另行分析。
steps.instructionEn: Use mass and temperature rise for basic teaching heat estimates; pressure-vessel states require separate analysis.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：m=1000 kg；cp=4 kJ/(kg·K)；教學升溫 ΔT=100 K。模型 Q=m cp ΔT，代入得到 400 MJ。適用邊界：教學顯熱估計，並非壓力容器操作溫度或程序。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: m=1000 kg; cp=4 kJ/(kg·K); teaching temperature rise ΔT=100 K. Model Q=m cp ΔT gives 400 MJ. Applicability: Teaching sensible-heat estimate, not pressure-vessel operating temperature or procedure.
steps.failure: 把顯熱式當作整套蒸汽設計。診斷與介入：補列熱損、回熱與物性，不以此式設定壓力容器。
steps.failureEn: Using sensible heat as a complete steam-system design fails. Diagnostic response: Add losses, heat recovery and material properties; do not use this equation to set a pressure vessel.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「水解顯熱模型」的觀測點。以封閉示意圖查找熱交換、蒸汽冷凝與損失項。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for hydrolysis sensible-heat model. Locate heat exchange, steam condensation and loss terms on a closed-system diagram. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
